systems.name: Payments V2 Datalocks
systems.description: This system processes data lock events and related apprenticeship updates, handling employer and provider account interactions as part of apprenticeship data validation workflows.

systems.name: Employer Finance
systems.description: This system appears to manage employer financial accounts, including transactions, payments, levy declarations, English fractions, transfers, and account-related workflows and settings.
capabilities: Audit logging for jobs and workflows

systems.name: Das Commitments
systems.description: This system facilitates the management of apprenticeship agreements, cohorts, and related interactions between employers and training providers. It supports functionalities such as apprenticeship tracking, cohort approval, data resolution, and transfer request handling.

systems.name: Das Reservations API
systems.description: The system manages reservations for apprenticeship training opportunities, courses, and related rules. It allows for creation, modification, validation, and deletion of reservations.

systems.name: Employer Accounts
systems.description: The system manages employer accounts, including their legal entities, PAYE schemes, agreements, user roles, and notifications. It integrates with multiple external APIs for functionalities such as levy data and organisational information retrieval.
